create_trainer: create a training.Trainer with a PyTorch model, optimizer, scheduler, and dataset for regression
build_model_config: build a PyTorchModelConfig with encoder/decoder vocabs and architecture kwargs for a regress_lm model
create_example_dataset: create an ExampleDataset from core.Example objects with string inputs and float targets
run_train_step: run a single training step on a batch using the Trainer's run_train_step method
run_eval_epoch: run an evaluation epoch on a data loader using the Trainer's run_eval_epoch method
